title: Showcase: Admin front desk (payments + attendance + kiosk)
description: See the front-desk path: open Payment Log and Attendance Log with seeded rows, then enter check-in kiosk mode.

steps.title: Admin home
steps.body: Administrators use the Admin menu for Payment Log, Attendance Log, Plans, and System Configuration.

steps.title: Open Admin menu
steps.body: Open the Admin dropdown to reach payment and attendance tools.

steps.title: Admin destinations
steps.body: Payment Log, Attendance Log, Payment Plans, and System Configuration are listed here.

steps.title: Open Payment Log
steps.body: Payment Log shows succeeded and pending payments. The tutorial DB seeds both.

steps.title: Payment Log with seed data
steps.body: You should see at least one Paid and one Pending row (cash awaiting Clear/Reject).
steps.resultNote: Seeded ClubPayment rows appear in the table.

steps.title: Open Attendance Log
steps.body: Attendance Log shows who is present today and any rejected check-ins.

steps.title: Attendance with present members
steps.body: Seeded open visits show under Only Present. Present count appears in the title.
steps.resultNote: Open ClubVisit rows for today’s club date are listed.

steps.title: Enter kiosk
steps.body: Front-desk check-in uses Kiosk → Check-in so members can use PINs without full admin chrome.

steps.title: Kiosk chooser
steps.body: Admins can choose Check-in; organizers typically use Browse.
steps.resultNote: Enter kiosk mode dialog is open.

steps.title: Start check-in mode
steps.body: Choose Check-in to show the attendance-oriented Players UI.

steps.title: Check-in kiosk
steps.body: Present count reflects seeded visits. Rows offer Check-in / Check-out. Use Restore privileges to exit.
steps.resultNote: Kiosk check-in UI is active with banner and Present filter.
